page.title: What you can actually buy
page.intro: The Central Bank caps mortgages at 4× gross income for first-time buyers and 3.5× for everyone else. Fill in your numbers and the results update as you go. Save them to your journey to complete step 1.

htb.notFtb: Help to Buy is for first-time buyers only, so it is not counted here.
htb.notNew: Help to Buy only covers new builds and self-builds. Choose New house or New apartment above if that is what you are buying.
htb.overCap: Help to Buy only covers homes up to {cap}, so it is not counted at this price.
htb.loanTooSmall: Help to Buy needs a mortgage of at least 70% of the price, which is {minLoan} here. You can borrow up to {maxLoan}, so it is not counted at this price.
htb.counted: Help to Buy gives back the income tax and DIRT you paid in the last four years, up to €30,000 or 10% of the price. On this price, the most is {most}.
htb.borrowEnough: It also needs a mortgage of at least 70% of the price ({minLoan}), so plan to borrow that much and keep the rest of your savings.

monthly.label: Estimated monthly repayment
monthly.note: {loan} over {years} at {rate}. Mortgage protection and home insurance are on top.

limit.income: Right now your income is the limit. The {multiple} rule caps the loan at {maxLoan}.
limit.savings: Right now your savings are the limit. Every extra €1,000 saved raises this by about {amount}.
limit.htbEdge: Right now your savings are the limit, at the highest price where Help to Buy still applies. Going above it without Help to Buy needs about {amount} more in savings.

save.label: Save to my journey
save.hint: Completes step 1. Your figures stay in this browser.
save.saved: Step 1 is done. Your journey always shows the figures on this page.
save.noJourney: Could not load your journey. Reload the page to save.
save.done: Your numbers are saved and step 1 is done.
save.updated: Your journey now uses these numbers.

breakdown.title: On a house
breakdown.loanAll: Mortgage needed, using all your savings
breakdown.stampNew: Stamp duty ({bands} of the price without {vat} VAT)
breakdown.booking: To secure the house you pay a booking deposit of roughly €5,000 (refundable until contracts are signed). The rest of the {deposit} deposit is due when you sign.

within.title: This price is within your limits
within.body: You have {funds} against {cash} needed in cash, and the mortgage of {loan} sits inside your {multiple} limit of {maxLoan}. Next step: gather the AIP paperwork.

outOfReach.title: This price is out of reach for now
outOfReach.body: You are {gap} short in cash, and the mortgage you would need ({loan}) is {over} above your {multiple} limit of {maxLoan}. Aim at or below {maxPrice}.

cashShort.title: You are {gap} short in cash
cashShort.body: You have {funds} available and need {cash} in cash at this price. Save the difference or aim closer to {maxPrice}.

loanOver.title: The mortgage is over your limit
loanOver.body: You would need to borrow {loan}, which is {over} above your {multiple} limit of {maxLoan}. Aim at or below {maxPrice}.

disclaimer: Educational estimates based on Central Bank of Ireland rules and Revenue's stamp duty and Help to Buy rules. Each lender applies its own credit criteria and exemptions.
